title: Dimension Input
summary: Labels each side of a size, fills all three from a pasted "16 x 12 x 8 in" and catches wrong units or an extra digit, so the wrong package size doesn't ship.
description: Labels each side, fills all three from a pasted "16 x 12 x 8 in", checks them against what is being measured to catch the wrong unit, an extra digit and sides in the wrong order, and reads the size back in metric and imperial with volume and volumetric weight.
catches: The wrong unit for the item category (cm entered as inches)
A side with an extra digit
Sides entered in an unexpected order
Pasted sizes like "16 x 12 x 8 in", split into fields
Courier volumetric weight, using your divisor
limits: Plausibility checks need a category; without one it only reads back
The default volumetric divisor may not match your courier
a11y: Each side and the unit have their own <label>
Fields are described by an aria-live="polite" status
